resources.string: Choose which apps use this VPN profile

Only selected apps use this VPN, subject to the original gateway and route settings. The VPN app retains tunnel access for its existing keepalive. This list shows apps visible to the current Android user. Use Show system apps for Google Play services. Shared UIDs share routing. Saving active rules reconnects the VPN. System lockdown can block direct traffic.
Could not load apps. Reopen this page to retry.
Clear all selected apps and turn off the whitelist? Tap Save to apply.
Select at least one installed, available app before enabling the whitelist. VPN connection was not started.
Skipped %1$d uninstalled or unavailable apps. Review the selection in App Split Tunneling.
Some selected packages could not be applied. No VPN interface was established. Check VPN diagnostics and correct the whitelist.
Could not save. Wait until authentication or reconnection finishes and try again. If it persists, check available storage.
Saved. Changes to active routing rules are applied by disconnecting and reconnecting.
Updates for this test build are available from your fork’s GitHub Actions.

These selected packages are unavailable or not visible: %1$s. Selections are preserved. Enable system apps to review them, or explicitly remove unavailable selections. VPN setup stops if any selected package cannot be applied.

Technical data stays in memory. Export includes selected package names, UIDs and VPN IP/DNS/routes; profile identity and domains are redacted. No authentication log, password, cookie or token is included. No automatic upload. Shared UIDs can share VPN routing. Review the file before sharing.
